planets.name: K2-370 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-370 with a 2.14-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: K2-370 b was found in 2022 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-370. Its orbit and size follow Sozzetti et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
